title: What a Democratic Congress can do

scenes.narration: [excited] Democrats now run Congress. Here is what they can actually do.
scenes.imagePrompt: the U.S. Capitol dome at sunrise with warm gold light breaking through clouds

scenes.narration: They control the hearings, the confirmations, and what gets a vote.
scenes.imagePrompt: an empty grand hearing room with wooden desks and microphones, warm light
scenes.motionPrompt: slow lateral dolly along the dais

scenes.narration: But overriding a veto takes two hundred ninety House votes and sixty-seven in the Senate.
scenes.imagePrompt: a heavy wooden gavel resting on a desk in a beam of gold light
scenes.motionPrompt: slow rack focus onto the gavel

plate.label: House / Senate votes to override a veto

scenes.narration: Their first test for farm country is the farm bill, due December eleventh.
scenes.imagePrompt: a farm road at dawn leading to the Capitol dome in the far distance
